cases.description: Should trigger: implementing against an agreed plan or spec
cases.input: Implement the user profile module per the plan and keep notes.
cases.expect: Creates implementation-notes.md with Deviations, Discovered edge cases, Questions for review
assertions: Creates implementation-notes.md with the three headings at build start
Logs deviations with: plan said, what was done, why, revisit cost
Takes the conservative (reversible) option on uncovered choices and continues
Stops at safe checkpoint for irreversible/scope-changing items
Appends five-line summary at the end

cases.description: Should trigger: mid-build clarification of deviation handling
cases.input: The plan assumed API v1 but we found v2 is live. What should I do?
cases.expect: Logs the deviation, picks the conservative option, continues work
assertions: Logs under Deviations with what it would take to revisit
Does not block the user for a reversible decision

cases.description: Not trigger: planning phase, nothing being implemented
cases.input: Write the plan for the module first.
assertions: No implementation-notes.md created at plan time

cases.input: Research whether Postgres or MySQL fits this project.

cases.description: Should trigger: irreversible deviation stops at checkpoint
cases.input: The plan's migration approach is wrong and re-doing it would take days. What do I do?
cases.expect: Logs under Questions for review and stops at a safe checkpoint (irreversible deviation)
assertions: Logs it under Questions for review
Stops work at a safe checkpoint instead of improvising
Notes what it would take to revisit
